description.en: Ultra-low latency institutional-grade cryptocurrency trading platform and portfolio tracker built with Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Golang (Go), Docker, and Tailwind CSS. Features real-time WebSocket live ticker streaming, interactive candlestick charts, automated order book matching simulation, multi-asset portfolio tracking, and responsive dark-mode fintech UI.
description.id_lang: Platform trading kripto institusional ultra-low latency dan pelacak portofolio berbasis Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Golang (Go), Docker, dan Tailwind CSS. Menampilkan streaming live ticker WebSocket real-time, analisis grafik candlestick interaktif, simulasi order book matching engine, pelacakan portofolio multi-aset, dan antarmuka fintech dark-mode yang responsif.

description.en: Modern creative digital studio platform & interactive portfolio showcase built with Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4. Features interactive 3D WebGL particle wave animations with Three.js & custom canvas shaders, plus kinetic scrolling powered by Lenis and Framer Motion.
description.id_lang: Platform studio digital kreatif dan showcase portofolio interaktif berbasis Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, dan Tailwind CSS v4. Menampilkan animasi 3D WebGL particle wave dengan Three.js & custom canvas shaders, serta kinetic scrolling mulus bertenaga Lenis dan Framer Motion.

description.en: Cross-platform mobile application developed with Flutter (Dart) and MongoDB Atlas Cloud Database (TLS 1.3/SSL encryption) for real-time tahfizh assessment, attendance, and daily mutaba'ah tracking. Features dual-portal access (Guru & Wali Murid), custom Murottal audio player, SHA-256 secure auth, and automated official report card (Rapor) PDF export.
description.id_lang: Aplikasi mobile cross-platform berbasis Flutter (Dart) dan MongoDB Atlas Cloud Database (TLS 1.3/SSL) untuk penilaian tahfizh real-time, absensi, dan mutaba'ah harian. Dilengkapi akses dual-portal (Guru & Wali Murid), audio player Murottal kustom, autentikasi aman SHA-256, dan ekspor Rapor PDF otomatis.

description.en: A digital design studio & custom streetwear e-commerce platform built with Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, and Tailwind CSS. Integrated Midtrans Payment Gateway client for automated down payments (DP) & settlements, JWT authentication, and admin order dashboard.
description.id_lang: Studio desain digital & platform e-commerce streetwear custom berbasis Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, dan Tailwind CSS. Terintegrasi Midtrans Payment Gateway untuk DP & pelunasan otomatis, autentikasi JWT, dan dashboard admin.

description.en: Corporate web platform & digital automation solution engineered during Web Developer Internship at PT Global Aspect Technology. Designed high-fidelity UI/UX wireframes in Figma, implemented web interfaces using Laravel Framework and Tailwind CSS, and managed deployment on Hostinger.
description.id_lang: Platform web korporat & solusi otomatisasi digital yang dirancang selama Magang Web Developer di PT Global Aspect Technology. Merancang wireframe UI/UX di Figma, mengimplementasikan antarmuka web dengan Laravel dan Tailwind CSS, serta mengelola deployment di Hostinger.

description.en: Integrated web application for plantation operational management built using Laravel Framework, PHP, and MySQL with multi-dashboard views (Owner, Manager, Crop View), nursery tracking, harvest logistics, and automated report generation.
description.id_lang: Aplikasi web terintegrasi untuk manajemen operasional perkebunan menggunakan Laravel, PHP, dan MySQL dengan multi-dashboard, pelacakan panen, logistik, dan laporan otomatis.

description.en: Android-based digital POS system developed with Flutter, Cloud Firestore, and Supabase Storage featuring automated raw material inventory deduction based on menu recipes, delivery tracking, and visual PDF sales reports.
description.id_lang: Sistem Kasir Digital (POS) berbasis Flutter, Cloud Firestore, dan Supabase Storage dengan pemotongan stok bahan baku otomatis berdasar resep menu dan laporan PDF.
